closed_convex_hull_reduction: The real-coupling feature family has the same closed convex hull as the union of the strictly-positive sector and the sector with the first N-1 couplings positive and the final coupling negative. Zero-edge canonical representatives lie in the closure of the strictly-positive sector by continuity.
holonomy: product_j sign(c_j), defined only when every edge is nonzero
limitations: The verifier is an exact finite sign-pattern audit for N<=10 plus a deterministic N=42 smoke test. The all-N gauge classification and closed-convex-hull reduction follow from the algebraic proof, not from extrapolation of these finite checks.

n42_deterministic_smoke.scope: smoke test only; the all-N statement is proved algebraically

theorem_scope: Vertex-sign gauge preserves every principal minor, at every order. For a proper edge support the support graph is a forest and all signs are gauge-removable. For full cycle support there are exactly two gauge classes, distinguished by Z2 holonomy. D42 preserves the holonomy and acts on the support/magnitude pattern.
